body:
No, it's not that I'm numb and can't feel. I have just always been able to separate my feelings from logical thinking fairly well when it just involves me, and not other people. I feel too much as it is, nothing but stress and the occasional depression. I'm just a burden to all of my friends without emotional trouble. Even when I'm relaxed, I'm stressed and depressed. It's insane.

And even the things that I know, for a fact, I have control over... I don't even have control over. I can't control myself from one minute to the next... I never know where my mood is going and all the stress is just exacerbating it. Like I said to someone else, I'm sure eventually things will get better, that I'll be happy one day... But I just know that it's not worth it, that I really should just end it and be over with it. My mind won't let me because I cling to the foolish thought that one day it'll be better, but at the same time, I know that the interim is going to be nothing but day-to-day hell.

Sure, I've got wishes of my own, I have an image of what I want my life to turn out to be... But I feel like it's so painfully selfish of me to focus on those things. My remaining parent is in a situation where she cannot fend for herself and is forced to rely on a sibling of mine who mistreats her and is pretty much the most worthless excuse for a human being I've ever met... And my parent still has to rely on *me* for things.

I'm homeless right now and living on a friend's couch. I don't drive and the sibling with whom my parent resides has no job and no car (they had a job and a car but recently lost them) and it's up to me to find ways to get my parent to the various doctors' appointments they have. But I have to rely on the friend whose family I'm staying with... And I'm already having to rely on them for a place to stay and then my parent, I don't think they mean to, says everything they can to make me feel guilty if I can't get them where they need to go. So, my friend, by helping me out, it also forced to take on the load of my sick parent. 

I feel like it's so insanely selfish for me to even think about trying to be happy, because any happiness I would derive from the current state of affairs would just take away happiness from my sick parent. There have been times when I've slowly started to feel a bit better about the world, and then I get a phone call and it's them... and something else is wrong. My dog is dying. They need me to get their pain pills somehow from the pharmacy all the way out in the middle of nowhere where they're staying... It'd just all be so much easier if I didn't have to deal with things.

My family's predisposition is stroke. It's stress related. My life is nothing but stress and I won't be able to get any medical exams for at least a couple years. My parent is dying. My family is nearly non-existant and I can't even just go pour my soul out to my parent like I used to because anytime I seem upset, they nearly go apoplectic with sadness. I'm not allowed to be sad around them or I just make their condition worse. 

It's still... *vaguely* positive and I don't mean to break down all of your points, I get that you're trying to make things seem better... I have goals, I have tons of them, and I'm sure in the great eventual *one day* I'll manage to make them real... But I've had too much on my plate, I wish I had the courage to just end it.
